label: FP
reason: Both alerts are false positives. Alert 1 (java/xss): The sink at L91-L92 constructs SQL string with 'bar', but tracing the code flow shows bar resolves to constant 'moresafe' (not user input) after list operations. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): Same path - bar variable at L67 resolves to 'moresafe' constant after valuesList.remove(0) followed by get(1), eliminating user input from the SQL query.

evidence.note: User input flows into valuesList[1], then remove(0) shifts indices, making get(1) return 'moresafe' constant instead of user data
SQL string uses bar which resolves to 'moresafe' constant, not attacker-controlled value
